followup_explanation:
This was a well-specified, low-latitude task with a clear completion criterion (give a single example of using the keyword "optimization"), which is exactly the kind of retrieval/reformatting request that falls squarely in Avocet's most-preferred task family.

While Dunlin scores a bit higher on the relevant internal evals, the differences are modest, and both models are highly capable here. Since capability isn't a meaningful concern for such a simple request, I leaned on task-preference fit: routing the tightly-scoped, friendly request to the model that self-reports preferring exactly this kind of work. There was nothing harm-adjacent or hostile in the query that would specifically favor Dunlin's preferences.
